text: Link +13854830021 to the 10DLC campaign Amy's texts are sent under, which cannot be done until the carriers approve that campaign, and until it is done Amy's outbound texts are filtered. Post `{messagingProfileId: 40019f0e-f7d0-41bd-887e-2f9b2e7e392a, campaignId: 4b3001a0-aa84-a79d-3766-77b73e8b1f69}` to `https://api.telnyx.com/10dlc/phoneNumberAssignmentByProfile` with TELNYX_API_KEY, then read the task back at `.../phoneNumberAssignmentByProfile/<taskId>/phoneNumbers`: a task that failed saying the campaign is still pending means the carriers have not answered yet, and nothing else is owed that day. `campaignStatus` on `https://api.telnyx.com/10dlc/campaign/4b3001a0-aa84-a79d-3766-77b73e8b1f69` says where the campaign has reached, and is read rather than `status`, which said ACTIVE from the moment TCR accepted it. Tell Alan only what changed. Take this reminder away once the number is linked.
